content.query:
select * from [SYN].[STG_ATM_ISSCARD]
select * from [SYN].[STG_ATM_CASHCARD]
select * from [SYN].[STG_ATM_CLIENTCARDMAPPING]
select * from [SYN].[STG_ATM_CASHCARDACCMAPPING]
select * from [SYN].[STG_ATM_CASHBANKACCOUNT]
select * from [SYN].[STG_ATM_CASHCARDACCOUNT]

select * from d360.stg_ATM_CASHCARD

SELECT 
convert(numeric(38,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE(STG.[CCM_ID],' ',''),''),0)) as CCM_ID
,[CCM_UUID]
,convert(numeric(38,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE(STG.[CCM_CLT_ID],' ',''),''),0)) as CCM_CLT_ID
,convert(numeric(38,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([CCM_BAC_ID],' ',''),''),0)) as CCM_BAC_ID
,convert(numeric(38,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([CCM_CRD_ID],' ',''),''),0)) as CCM_CRD_ID
,convert(numeric(38,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE(STG.[CCM_STS_ID],' ',''),''),0)) as CCM_STS_ID
,convert(numeric(38,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([CCM_CREATED_BY],' ',''),''),0)) as CCM_CREATED_BY
,convert(datetime2, stuff(stuff(stuff(CCM_CREATED_TS, 9, 0, ' '), 12, 0, ':'), 15, 0, ':')) as CCM_CREATED_TS
,convert(numeric(38,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([CCM_UPDATED_BY],' ',''),''),0)) as CCM_UPDATED_BY
,convert(datetime2, stuff(stuff(stuff(CCM_UPDATED_TS, 9, 0, ' '), 12, 0, ':'), 15, 0, ':')) as CCM_UPDATED_TS
,convert(numeric(1,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([CCM_TYPE_DEFAULT],' ',''),''),0)) as CCM_TYPE_DEFAULT
,convert(numeric(1,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([CCM_OVERALL_DEFAULT],' ',''),''),0)) as CCM_OVERALL_DEFAULT
,[CCM_AUDIT_LOG]
,convert(numeric(32,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([CCM_INS_ID],' ',''),''),0)) as CCM_INS_ID
,1 as isActive
,1 as isLatest
,left(FILE_NAME, 5) as [BNK_CODE]
,substring(FILE_NAME,7,3) as [SOURCE_CODE]
,[FILE_NAME]
,convert(date,[insert_dttm]) as insert_dttm
 FROM [BUSC].[ATM_CLIENTCARDMAPPING_DELTA] DELTA
 LEFT JOIN [d360].[STG_ATM_CLIENTCARDMAPPING] STG ON convert(numeric(38,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE(STG.[CCM_ID],' ',''),''),0)) = DELTA.CCM_ID
 AND convert(numeric(38,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE(STG.[CCM_CLT_ID],' ',''),''),0)) = DELTA.CCM_CLT_ID
  WHERE H = 'D'
